title: investigation
$comment: H-056, H-060, H-061 (PROPOSED, pending the owner's confirmation of the D-008 amendment, ADR-032, the worker grants, the approval-record change and the background clock copy; behind GEMINUS_INVESTIGATIONS, off by default): an AI investigation. A person (owner or editor) starts it; its planner (Muse Spark 1.3) picks one of the seven tools of investigator.schema.json at each step, the API carries each call out in the person's name under a stored acting-for scope, re-reading their role every time, and every row it makes is labelled as the AI's. It keeps going after the page closes until it finishes, is stopped or reaches 20 minutes; a person publishes. Caps (H-060): 3 what-ifs, 4 runs, 4 explanations, 14 steps, 20 minutes, runs of at most 10 replications and 28 days, 1 running per person, 10 per organization per UTC day, USD 2.50.

InvestigationObjectiveMetric.description: The metrics an investigation may aim at. Lower is better for lead time, higher for throughput (fixed by the server).

InvestigationObjectiveChoice.description: The metric a person asks the investigation to improve.

InvestigationObjective.description: What the investigation aims at, with the direction the server fixes for the metric.

InvestigationHorizon.description: At most 28 days in any unit (H-060).

InvestigationRunConfig.description: The run settings of every run the investigation starts (simulation.schema.json RunConfig's members, within H-060's caps: at most 10 replications and 28 days). Frozen at creation; no tool takes settings.

warmup.description: Shorter than the horizon (checked by the server: 422 at /run_config/warmup).

InvestigationFromRequest.description: Entry A: an investigation asked for in words on the model page.

base_version_id.description: The model's latest version (409 MODEL_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). Every proposal, scenario and run of the investigation is on it.

mode.description: scenario: what-ifs, saved and run against a baseline; edit: one change written into a clean draft.

intent.description: What the person wants, in their words (untrusted; never in audit). Only white space is 422 at /intent.

output_locale.description: Language of the AI's prose; en when absent.

research.description: H-046 (2): web research before the first proposal only; false when absent. 422 at /research when that proposal's research reservation cannot fit the investigation's USD 2.50.

model.description: H-049: the proposal model; absent is the deployment's model.

planner_model.description: The planner; muse-spark-1.3 when absent. 422 at /planner_model when this deployment does not offer it.

run_config.description: Required in scenario mode, refused in edit mode.

baseline_name.description: The baseline run's name; required with run_config.

objective.description: Scenario mode only; the median lead time when absent.

InvestigationFromAnalysis.description: Entry B: "Let the AI test these" under a finished analysis (H-052's page), in scenario mode.

from_analysis_id.description: A completed analysis of one of this model's runs against a baseline whose patch is [] and whose settings fit the caps; its baseline is reused and its suggestions seed the investigation.

InvestigationRequest.description: createInvestigation's body: from a request (entry A) or from an analysis (entry B). No member names caps, limits, steps or a user.

InvestigationAccepted.description: createInvestigation's 202: stored with its one investigation job; nothing is proposed yet (the AI's first call does that).

StopInvestigation.description: stopInvestigation's body: a closed empty object (a stop takes no option).

InvestigationPlanner.description: The planner that picks the steps: "Done by Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta) for you".

InvestigationCaps.description: H-060's caps, frozen at creation (runs is 3 when a person's baseline is reused; edit mode: 1, 0, 0).

InvestigationUsed.description: What the investigation used, counted from its rows.

InvestigationActivity.description: What it is doing now: queued (no worker has it yet), planning (the AI is choosing), carrying_out (a call waits for the API), waiting (for a proposal, runs or an explanation), ended.

InvestigationStepTool.description: The step's tool, or invalid_call for model output that named no offered tool or did not decode.

InvestigationStepEffect.description: What a carried-out call made (references only).

InvestigationStep.description: One AI step: a row of the tool-call ledger (H-061 §5, §11).

arguments.description: The call's arguments as the server decoded and stored them (canonical); null for invalid_call. idea and question are AI text.

status.description: pending: asked, not yet carried out (still pending when the investigation ended: not carried out); done: carried out; refused or failed: with error.

anyOf.description: The AI's note on why it made the call: AI text, sanitized, shown labelled, never fed back to it.
When the worker recorded what the AI was shown; null while it waits for the proposal, the runs or the explanation.

allOf.$comment: invalid_call records model output that did not decode: refused, no arguments stored.

InvestigationCandidate.description: One what-if (or the one edit) of the investigation, with the API's own comparison of its run against the baseline (the same figures the AI was shown).

source.description: idea: the AI's own words; suggestion: one of an analysis's suggested experiments (from_suggestion).

idea.description: The idea argument of the call (AI text).

InvestigationBest.description: The server's best comparable what-if: by the objective's relative change in its fixed direction, then fewer operations, then index.

InvestigationStop.description: Who stopped it (the requester or an owner), and when.

InvestigationClosingLine.description: The server's closing line: a catalog key and server figures only (the ranking of internal/investigations over the stored comparisons). P0 tests no significance, and the UI says so.

key.description: The catalog template the UI words in the output locale: improved (the best comparable what-if moved the objective the right way), no_improvement (none of the compared did), not_compared (no pair could be compared), draft_written / draft_not_written (edit mode).

compared.description: How many what-ifs had a comparable pair.

Investigation.description: getInvestigation, listInvestigations' items and stopInvestigation's 200. No step counter or next action: the steps are the ledger's rows.

deadline_at.description: 20 minutes after created_at, queue time included.

allOf.$comment: The AI's claimed outcome exists exactly when it called finish.
